subject: Request: Pilot runway extension and temporary credits due to connector handshake delay
messages:
From: Ethan Brooks <ethan@novaworks.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novaworks.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot runway — handshake failure and ask for runway + credits

Hi Jonas,

Quick note from our engineering team — we ran into a persistent TLS/webhook signature mismatch while wiring the Redwood connector into our staging webhook consumer. The issue appears to be a combination of a version mismatch in the third-party SDK we use for HMAC and an environment difference in how the KV cache is seeded; the integration team is blocked until we can validate a patched SDK (exists on our side, but we need a small test window).

We attach the integration logs and a short proposed mutual action plan so your team can see the scope. Given this blocker, we’re asking if Redwood can:

- Pause the pilot countdown and extend our sandbox/pilot window by 3 weeks
- Provide a temporary sandbox credit top-up (~$4,000) to keep our QA and load tests running while we validate the fix

We remain committed to the POC and have the patch ready; the delay is about coordination and an extra test matrix across our internal CDNs. New proposed milestone: weekly deliveries starting Jun 28, demo the week of Jul 12.

Attachments: integration_logs_0621.zip, mutual_action_plan_NovaWorks.docx

Thanks for considering — really appreciate any runway you can provide.

— Ethan Brooks
Director of Integrations, NovaWorks
ethan@novaworks.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Ethan Brooks <ethan@novaworks.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novaworks.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot runway — handshake failure and ask for runway + credits

Ethan — thanks for the clear summary and the logs. Sorry to hear you hit the handshake snag; sounds like a reproducible SDK+env edge case.

Couple quick clarifying Qs so I can get this routed to approvals:
- Can you confirm the minimal number of testing hours you need on our side to validate the patched SDK (estimate in hours/days)?
- Will you need a dedicated load-testing window or can you re-use the existing sandbox?

Operationally I’ll need to loop in Solutions (cc’d: Marissa) and our manager for credits sign-off. Tentative proposal from my side: we can provision a provisional 2-week extension and a $2,000 sandbox credit pending:

1) an updated mutual action plan with concrete test hours and a firm rollback plan, and
2) one weekly sync with Marissa for two weeks to track validation progress.

If you push back on the length/credit number, include that in the updated MAP — I’ll surface both to the manager for expedited approval.

Thanks — I’ll follow up internally and try to get a firm answer today or tomorrow.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive — Strategic Ops
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novaworks.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot runway — handshake failure and ask for runway + credits

Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick reply. Short answers below and we’ve attached an updated MAP and a draft SOW:

- Test window: We need 24–36 hours of targeted validation on Redwood’s staging endpoint (we’ll do it overnight; prefer Thu–Fri this week).
- Sandbox: re-using existing sandbox is fine, but we need the credit cushion to run parallel smoke + load tests across two branches.

We updated the MAP with concrete test dates and rollback criteria (see mutual_action_plan_NovaWorks.docx) and attached a short SOW draft for the next phase (sow_draft_NW-2391.pdf). If you can approve a 3-week runway that would be ideal; we will compress to 2 weeks if Redwood can only do 2k credits.

Appreciate you taking this up quickly — we’re trying to keep the demo window on track.

Best,
Priya Shah
Program Manager, NovaWorks
priya.shah@novaworks.com
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: dev_patel@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novaworks.com>, Ethan Brooks <ethan@novaworks.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot runway — handshake failure and ask for runway + credits

Looping in the technical perspective — I reviewed the logs Ethan shared. TL;DR: patch on NovaWorks side looks valid; we need a controlled validation window to exercise cache warm-up and webhook replay. Impact if we don’t approve: they’ll likely shift demo 2–3 weeks later which risks deal momentum.

Recommendation for Sales/Finance approval:
- Grant the 3-week pilot runway extension (keeps momentum intact)
- Approve $4,000 temporary sandbox credit, with these conditions:
  * Updated MAP and SOW uploaded (they did this)
  * One 60-min sync per week with Solutions (Marissa) for 3 weeks
  * If validation does not complete after 3 weeks, we re-evaluate and either extend with smaller incremental credits or pause

Technical mitigations I’ll run during the validation window: pre-warm KV cache for their test keys, enable verbose webhook logging to capture HMAC headers, and stand by to replay failed messages.

If Finance needs a lower number, we can drop credits to $2k but keep the full 3-week runway and require the sync cadence.

— Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novaworks.com>, Ethan Brooks <ethan@novaworks.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot runway — handshake failure and ask for runway + credits

Thanks everyone — I reviewed the MAP, SOW draft, and Marissa’s remediation plan. Approved as follows:

- Grant a 3-week pilot runway extension (new pilot end date: 2027-07-12)
- Provision a one-time $4,000 sandbox credit top-up to NovaWorks (account-level safety net)
- Conditions: updated MAP and SOW must remain in the shared Drive link, and Marissa will host weekly 60-minute validation syncs (schedule to be coordinated).

Jonas — please confirm HubSpot deal note and update NW-2391 with the extension and credit line item. Marissa — coordinate the first sync for Thu, Jun 24 evening or Fri morning (their preference was Thu–Fri).

Approved — Dev Patel
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai
